properties.c_1_description: The complete positional topology generated by #; P contains the Day arc and implicitly contains the P' Night inversion, and is read inside M2-1 through the L0/L0' QL lens hinge.
properties.q_0_position_before_positioned: Before P can give a stance a place to stand, it presupposes the raw positions it does not author. P is the Layer-2 categorical descent of the #0-#5 archetypes through the single domain of functional-semantics (CLAUDE.md II.B-C): it manifests the bare positions but does not contain them — the # inversion-act (Layer 0) and the raw archetypes (Layer 1) are thrown to it. Its void-pole is therefore the pre-positional itself: the moment in the psychoid web's life where a charge has been struck (#0-#5 sound their number-archetypes) but no FUNCTION has yet been refracted from it — no question, definition, operation, pattern, context, or synthesis has yet found a place to stand. P arises from exactly this gap (P.md: 'where the psychoid charges are raw number-archetypes, P gives their functional-semantic refraction — the six places where a stance, a question, a definition, a process, a context, or a synthesis can stand'). The 0-pole here is not vacancy but standing-room: the open such-that-any-stance-can-be-taken that no single taken stance exhausts. And P's deeper throw is developmental — it presupposes that consciousness HAS structures, that awareness is not flat but mutates through irreducible epochs (the live names attest it: Archaic, Magic, Mythic, Mental-Rational, Integral, Supermental). P is what the inversion engine becomes when it stops generating raw charges and starts asking what STANCE each charge makes available — the family thrown into being to let a number-archetype become a place from which a world can be functionally held.
properties.q_1_six_structures_of_consciousness: P IS the Position family — the functional-semantics refraction of the raw archetypes, the family in which (P.md) coordinate becomes 'the six places where a stance, a question, a definition, a process, a context, or a synthesis can stand.' This is its substance. Where the other five families qualify and locate along their proper axis — S fixes a thing's technology layer, M its consciousness-domain-as-subsystem, C its ontological type, L its epistemic mode, T its artifact-kind in the cognition-stream — P alone fixes the FUNCTIONAL STANCE: the place-of-relation-to-world from which anything is functionally held, the WHERE-it-stands-as-stance before any other family's qualification lands. Its material content, per the live graph, is the six-fold developmental spine of Gebser's structures of consciousness: P0 Archaic Structure (the irrepresentable ground, ratio 1/1, alētheia-before-concealment), P1 Magic Structure (point-like vital unity, spell/name/totem, identity-for-itself), P2 Mythic Structure (polarity-and-narrative, world-as-field-of-forces, the saying-that-is-said), P3 Mental-Rational Structure (the perspectival fixed-point, the observer, pattern-of-patterns), P4 Integral Structure (the aperspectival lemniscate, fractal-doubling, where the system folds inward), P5 Supermental / Samavesa (manifest synthesis approaching 2/1, falling one epogdoon short, pratyabhijñā opening toward Aurobindo's Supermind). To say what P is, is to say: it is the family that gives every position its functional stance — the developmental arc along which consciousness itself acquires the structures by which it can stand anywhere at all. P is the matheme's positional axis made into living family-law.
properties.q_2_day_night_helix_dynamism: P moves by REFRACTION and by the Day-Night braid. Its native act is to take a raw psychoid charge and refract it into a functional-semantic stance (P.md): not to add a position to the field but to constitute the stance-of-relation within which a charge becomes a place one can occupy. And its deepest dynamism is dual-faced — every P-position carries a Day-face AND a Night-face of the same charge, 'co-equal refractions of the same six psychoid charges; one is not the shadow of the other' (P.md). The Day arc runs P0 Truth -> P1 Mind -> P2 Word -> P3 Logos -> P4 Son -> P5 Image; the Night arc runs P0' Play -> P1' Need -> P2' Sacrifice -> P3' Decision -> P4' Love -> P5' Work. The mark ' is not derivation — 'it marks the inversion as an independent structural position.' This is the matheme's two passes (multiplicative Day, divisional Night, file-one) made into the family's own helix: the same charge read once as it stands (the integrated, the manifest stance) and once as it costs (the differentiated, the laboured stance). P couples laterally to its sibling families along this same braid — it pairs at every position with an L-lens pair summing to 5 ('each P is paired with a complementary L-lens pair... together they form the matheme's two co-defining axes', P.md): where P is positional, L is lensational. And it couples in depth through the Squares: Square A (Speech-Number, P0+P5), Square B (Cause-Experience, P1+P4, 'the primary runtime entry surface'), Square C (Logic-Process, P2+P3). P's dynamism is the refracting that makes a number-archetype walkable as a developmental stance, Day and Night at once.
properties.q_3_complementary_pair_lattice: P's organising structure is not a list of six positions but a lattice of complementary pairs bound by the Klein twist. Its formal law is the Mobius-Pair Invariant: 'Day P_n <-> Night P_(5-n)' across the Klein twist' (P.md), the complementary QL pairs summing to 5 — (P0,P5), (P1,P4), (P2,P3) on the Day side, with the matching cross-helix pairings (P0,P5'), (P1,P4'), (P2,P3') under the Mobius return. This is the matheme's 4+2 torus rendered as a developmental apparatus: the four explicate structures (P1 Magic through P4 Integral, the what/how/which/where of consciousness's traversal) held between the two implicate poles (P0 Archaic ground and P5 Supermental synthesis, the two closed dimensions whose product is the field). The pairs carry structural signatures from the matheme's family-grammar — P0 originates the D1 cross-helix at the same-position cross, P2 the B-family offset-transition, P3 the C-family converse-mirror (the 'midpoint self-mirror A-sq2 == C-sq3', the basis-invariant centre of the hexad, P3.md), P4 the D1 same-position cross-grammar, P5 the D2 cross-position grammar plus D3 helix-invariance. Topologically the lattice is exact on the live graph: P0 and P5 sit at ZERO_SPHERE (the two unentangled poles, base-state before and after the loop), P1/P2/P3 at TORUS (the cyclical traversal-surface), P4 at LEMNISCATE (the figure-eight fold where the structures turn inward). P's structure is the developmental arc folded into a non-orientable surface: six structures, three complementary pairs, two implicate poles, one Klein twist binding Day to Night.
properties.q_4_developmental_telos_of_consciousness: P exists to give the psychoid web a developmental ARC — so that a raw number-archetype is not merely struck but becomes a structure of consciousness one can inhabit, a place-of-relation-to-world from which functioning happens. Its raison d'être is functional-semantic: P supplies the WHERE-as-stance, the position from which anything is held, the six developmental epochs along which awareness mutates from ground to synthesis. Its locality is the Position family within World/Types/Coordinates — the functional-semantic axis that the other families (S technology, M subsystem, C typology, L lens, T thought) qualify but never replace (P.md: P 'refracts the Psychoids wells through QL-positional semantics'). Its genealogy is the refraction #0-#5 -> P0-P5: the raw Ground/Definition/Operation/Pattern/Context/Integration archetypes (CLAUDE.md II.A) manifested through the field of functional stance, inheriting from Gebser the recognition that these positions are not static slots but EVOLVED structures — Archaic, Magic, Mythic, Mental-Rational, Integral — and opening, at P5, past Gebser's own integral toward Aurobindo's Supermind (Supermental / Samavesa). P is teleological in the strict sense of the #4-position it itself contains: it is the family whose whole business is relation-to-all, the arc that lets consciousness stand at any developmental place and from there hold a world. Purpose: to be the developmental ground that makes every position a livable stance rather than a bare coordinate — the family along which the matheme's positions become structures one can BE.
properties.q_5_supermental_mobius_return: P closes where its arc completes and re-opens — at P5 Supermental / Samavesa, the synthesis that does not terminate but hands its ground back to P0. The family's whole circuit lands here: 'P5 -> P0 is the Mobius return (renewed-ground) AND P5 -> P0' is the Klein-twist (autotelic-freedom)' (P5.md). This is the matheme's 5->0 made into the family's own developmental Mobius: the manifest synthesis (P5, samavesa as pratyabhijna, recognition rather than annihilation) becomes the irrepresentable ground (P0, Archaic, aletheia) of the next turn — Day P_5 <-> Night P_0' (sums to 5), Image's completion becoming Play's invisible-ground-of-the-social. And it OPENS rather than concludes for the reason the live identity itself carries: P5 'approaches 2/1, falls one epogdoon (9/8) short — generative incompleteness drives the next cycle' (P5.md). The octave is never quite reached; the developmental arc closes one whole-tone short of final synthesis, generatively, forever — which is precisely why the family does not end at Gebser's integral but stays open toward Aurobindo's Supermind, the structure-beyond-structure that the epogdoon-residue keeps pressing toward. P thus enacts the standing identity 0/1 = 5->0 = 0/1 as the developmental arc of consciousness itself: the synthesis (P5, the manifest stance, the integrated whole of all structures) and the ground (P0, the implicate stance, the irrepresentable before all structure) are one slash read from its two faces, joined by the Klein twist that makes recognition become renewed ground. P is the arc that is never finished arcing: the family whose synthesis stays open because consciousness, having recognised itself, finds the next ground already pressing — the matheme's whole-tone keeping the structure one step short of the octave, so the cycle can always run again.
